class.name: FellowWheel3D
class.brief_description: A wheel of a FellowVehicle3D: its suspension, its tyre, and what it does (FellowEngine).
class.description: A wheel of its parent [FellowVehicle3D]: the node marks the wheel's centre with its suspension fully extended (its mount is [member suspension_length] above, along the node's Y); its X is the axle and the car's forward is [code]-Z[/code]. While the game runs the vehicle moves the node down its suspension, steers it and turns it by its spin: give it the wheel's meshes as children. The editor draws the wheel and its suspension's travel.

method.name: get_compression
method.description: Returns how far the suspension is pushed in (metres).

method.name: get_contact_point
method.description: Returns the tyre's contact with the ground (global), when [method is_in_contact].

method.name: get_ground
method.description: Returns the node the wheel stands on, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_load
method.description: Returns the suspension's force on the ground (N).

method.name: get_rpm
method.description: Returns the wheel's revolutions per minute.

method.name: get_slip_angle
method.description: Returns the angle between where the wheel points and where its contact moves (radians).

method.name: get_slip_ratio
method.description: Returns how much faster the wheel turns than the ground passes under it, over the speed (negative braking).

method.name: is_in_contact
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the wheel touches the ground.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the brakes act on this wheel.
The damper's force per metre a second of the suspension's compression (N·s/m).
The damper's force per metre a second of the suspension's extension (N·s/m).
If [code]true[/code], the engine drives this wheel.
The tyre's peak friction coefficient, times the ground's friction (its physics material's).
If [code]true[/code], the handbrake acts on this wheel.
The wheel's moment of inertia about its axle (kg·m²).
The tyre's rolling resistance: the share of its load that holds the wheel back as it rolls (a torque of this times the load times the [member radius]; it holds a stopped wheel on a gentle slope).
The suspension's spring: its force per metre of compression (N/m).
If [code]true[/code], the steering turns this wheel.
The suspension's travel (metres): from the mount to the wheel's centre fully extended.
